questions.prompt: Tell me about your typical day.
questions.sampleA1: I wake up. I eat. I go to work. I sleep.
questions.sampleA2: I wake up at seven. I eat breakfast, and then I go to work. I work until five o'clock. Then I go home and eat dinner. I watch TV and go to sleep.
questions.sampleB1: Well, usually I wake up around 7 am. I have some breakfast and then I go to work. My work is okay. In the evening, I usually cook dinner or sometimes I go out with friends. I think my typical day is pretty normal, but I enjoy it.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, my days are pretty much the same. I drag myself out of bed around seven, grab a quick coffee and head off to uni. The afternoons are usually back-to-back lectures, and in the evening I like to wind down with a series or catch up with friends. I suppose it's nothing special, but it suits me.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men uyg'onaman. Men ovqat yeyman. Men ishga boraman. Men uxlayman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men soat yettida uyg'onaman. Nonushta qilaman, keyin ishga boraman. Men soat beshgacha ishlayman. Keyin uyga boraman va kechki ovqat yeyman. Televizor ko'raman va uxlayman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, odatda men ertalab soat 7 atrofida uyg'onaman. Nonushta qilaman va keyin ishga boraman. Ishim yaxshi. Kechqurun odatda ovqat tayyorlayman yoki ba'zan do'stlarim bilan ko'chaga chiqaman. O'ylashimcha, mening odatiy kunim juda oddiy, lekin menga yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Mening odatdagi kunim odatda erta, taxminan soat 6:30 da uyg'onish bilan boshlanadi. Ishdan oldin biroz mashq qilishga harakat qilaman, balki tez yugurish yoki biroz yoga. Shundan so'ng, odatdagi qatnov va ofisda bir kun. Kechqurunlari, kitob o'qish yoki do'stlar bilan uchrashish orqali ishdan uzilishga harakat qilaman. Mening kun tartibim ancha bir xil bo'lsa-da, men har doim har bir kunni biroz boshqacharoq qilish uchun kichik yo'llarni topishga harakat qilaman.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Tell me about your typical day.
idioms: the early bird catches the worm - "erta turgan kishiga omad kuladi"
a creature of habit - "odatga bo'ysunuvchi odam"
burn the midnight oil - "kechgacha ishlash/o'qish"
sentenceStarters: "Well, my typical day is fairly structured…" - "Menimcha, mening oddiy kunim ancha tartibli…"
"In the evening, I like to unwind by…" - "Kechqurun men … qilib dam olishni yaxshi ko'raman"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Well, my typical day is fairly structured. I usually wake up around 7 in the morning, have a quick breakfast, and then head off to my classes. After studying, I normally spend some time reviewing my notes or working on assignments.
In the evening, I like to unwind by going for a short walk or watching something online. I try to stick to a routine because it helps me stay organised and productive. As they say, "the early bird catches the worm" — starting the day early really makes a difference.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xo'sh, mening odatdagi kunim ancha rejalashtirilgan. Odatda ertalab soat 7 larda uyg'onaman, tezda nonushta qilaman va keyin darslarimga yo'l olaman. O'qishdan so'ng, odatda, bir oz vaqtni yozuvlarimni ko'rib chiqishga yoki topshiriqlar ustida ishlashga sarflayman.

Kechqurun, qisqa sayrga chiqish yoki internetda biror narsa tomosha qilish orqali dam olishni yoqtiraman. Men odatda rejimga rioya qilishga harakat qilaman, chunki bu menga tartibli va unumli bo'lishga yordam beradi. Aytishlaricha, "ertalab turgan o'jar, o'z rizqini topadi" — kunni erta boshlash haqiqatan ham katta farq qiladi.

questions.sampleA1: I like Ronaldo. He is good. He plays football. I watch him.
questions.sampleA2: I like Serena Williams. She is a tennis player and she is very good. I like her because she wins many games. She is strong and I watch her on TV.
questions.sampleB1: My favourite sportsperson is probably Roger Federer. I think he's a really talented tennis player. He's also very elegant on the court. For example, his backhand is amazing. However, he is getting older now, but he's still one of the best.
questions.sampleB2: Well, without a doubt it'd have to be Cristiano Ronaldo. The thing is, it's not just his talent — what really stands out is his work ethic. He goes the extra mile in every single training session. I honestly find his sheer determination inspiring, and he's proof that hard graft pays off in the end.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga Ronaldu yoqadi. U yaxshi. U futbol o'ynaydi. Men uni tomosha qilaman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga Serena Uilyams yoqadi. U tennis o'yinchisi va u juda yaxshi. Menga u ko'p o'yinlarda g'alaba qozonganligi uchun yoqadi. U kuchli va men uni televizorda ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Mening eng sevimli sportchim, ehtimol, Rojer Federer. Menimcha, u juda iste'dodli tennischi. U kortda ham juda nafis.
Masalan, uning orqa zarbasi ajoyib. Biroq, u hozir qarib bormoqda, lekin u hali ham eng yaxshilardan biri.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Mening eng sevimli sportchim Rafael Nadal bo'lsa kerak. Men uning qat'iyatliligini va kurashuvchan ruhini qoyil qoldiraman. U hech qachon taslim bo'lmaydi, hisob yoki raqibidan qat'i nazar. Uning sportga bo'lgan sadoqati qattiq mashg'ulot rejimida va eng yuqori darajadagi doimiy o'yinlarida yaqqol ko'rinadi.
Bundan tashqari, u chinakam kamtarin va hurmatli insondek tuyuladi, bu esa uni yanada hayratlanarli qiladi. U haqiqiy namuna.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Who is your favourite sportsperson?
idioms: go the extra mile - "qo'shimcha harakat qilmoq"
raise the bar - "mezonni yuqoriga ko'tarmoq"
a cut above the rest - "boshqalardan bir bosh baland"
sentenceStarters: "My favourite sportsperson is undoubtedly…" - "Mening sevimli sportchim, shubhasiz…"
"His career has shown that with discipline…" - "Uning karyerasi … bilan ko'rsatdi"

questions.sampleAnswer:
My favourite sportsperson is undoubtedly Cristiano Ronaldo. I've always admired his incredible work ethic and determination. What sets him apart is not just his natural talent, but the sheer dedication he puts into training every single day.
He's a living example of the saying "hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard." His career has shown that with discipline and perseverance, you can reach the very top, which is truly inspiring for young people like me.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Mening eng sevimli sportchim, shubhasiz, Cristiano Ronaldo. Men uning aql bovar qilmas mehnatsevarligi va qat'iyatiga doimo qoyil qolganman. Uni boshqalardan ajratib turadigan narsa faqatgina tabiiy iste'dodi emas, balki u har kuni mashg'ulotlarga sarflaydigan benuqson fidoyilikdir.

U "iste'dod mehnat qilmasa, qattiq mehnat iste'dodni yengadi" degan maqolning tirik namunasidir. Uning faoliyati shuni ko'rsatdiki, intizom va matonat bilan eng yuqori cho'qqilarga erishish mumkin, bu men kabi yoshlar uchun haqiqatan ham ilhomlantiruvchi.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of regular sports?
questions.sampleA1: I like sports. It is good. I play football. It is fun.
questions.sampleA2: Sports are good for you. I like to play football and basketball. It is good for my body. I feel happy when I play, and I can meet friends.
questions.sampleB1: I think regular sports are very important. For example, they help you stay healthy and fit. Also, sports can be fun and a good way to relax. I play tennis sometimes, and it helps me to de-stress. However, it's important to be careful and not get injured.
questions.sampleB2: To my mind, the benefits are huge. First off, staying active keeps you in shape and boosts your immune system. But it's not just physical — a good workout really helps you let off steam and clear your head. On top of that, team sports teach you to pull together, which is a valuable life skill.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men sportni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu yaxshi. Men futbol o'ynayman. Bu qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleA2: Sport bilan shug'ullanish siz uchun foydali. Men futbol va basketbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu mening tanam uchun yaxshi. O'ynaganimda o'zimni baxtli his qilaman va do'stlar bilan uchrashishim mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, muntazam sport bilan shug'ullanish juda muhim.
Masalan, ular sog'lom va baquvvat bo'lishga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, sport qiziqarli va dam olishning yaxshi usuli bo'lishi mumkin. Men ba'zan tennis o'ynayman va bu menga stressdan xalos bo'lishga yordam beradi.
Biroq, ehtiyot bo'lish va jarohat olmaslik muhim.
questions.uzSampleB2: Muntazam sport bilan shug'ullanishning bir qancha foydalari bor. Albatta, bu sizning jismoniy sog'lig'ingiz uchun yaxshi; u sog'lom vaznni saqlashga yordam beradi va yurak-qon tomir tizimini mustahkamlaydi. Bundan tashqari, sport sizning ruhiy holatingizni sezilarli darajada yaxshilashi mumkin. Bu stressni bartaraf etish va kayfiyatingizni ko'tarishning ajoyib usuli. Bundan tashqari, ayniqsa, jamoaviy sport turlari sizga jamoada ishlash va yetakchilik kabi qimmatli hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishi mumkin. Shunday qilib, umuman olganda, men muntazam sportni kundalik hayotingizga kiritish sizning umumiy sog'lig'ingiz va baxtingizga qilingan arzirli sarmoya deb hisoblayman.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - What are the benefits of regular sports?
idioms: a healthy mind in a healthy body - "sog'lom tanda — sog'lom aql"
no pain, no gain - "og'riqsiz yutuq bo'lmaydi"
keep the ball rolling - "harakatni davom ettirmoq"
sentenceStarters: "There are numerous benefits to doing regular sports…" - "Muntazam sport bilan shug'ullanishning ko'plab foydasi bor…"
"Beyond the physical advantages, sports also…" - "Jismoniy foydalari bilan bir qatorda, sport shuningdek…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are numerous benefits to doing regular sports. First and foremost, physical activity keeps our body fit and healthy — it boosts the immune system, strengthens muscles, and helps maintain a healthy weight.
Beyond the physical advantages, sports also have a tremendously positive impact on mental well-being. Exercise releases endorphins, which reduce stress and improve mood. Additionally, team sports teach invaluable life skills like cooperation, discipline, and resilience.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Muntazam sport bilan shug'ullanishning ko'plab foydalari bor. Avvalo, jismoniy faollik tanamizni sog'lom va baquvvat saqlaydi — u immunitet tizimini mustahkamlaydi, mushaklarni kuchaytiradi va sog'lom vaznni saqlashga yordam beradi.

Jismoniy afzalliklardan tashqari, sportning ruhiy farovonlikka ham juda katta ijobiy ta'siri bor. Jismoniy mashqlar endorfinlarni chiqaradi, bu stressni kamaytiradi va kayfiyatni yaxshilaydi. Bundan tashqari, jamoaviy sport turlari hamkorlik, intizom va chidamlilik kabi bebaho hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatadi.

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1: I see a family. They clean. And a robot.
questions.sampleA2: I see a family. They are cleaning the house. And I see a robot. The robot is cleaning too, but it's different because it's not a family.
questions.sampleB1: In the first picture, I see a family cleaning. They look happy. They are working together. In the second picture, I see a robot cleaning. I think it's interesting because one is a family and the other is a robot.
questions.sampleB2: Both pictures are related to household chores, but they show completely different approaches. In the first one, a family is cleaning the floor together manually. They're all getting their hands dirty, so to speak, and it looks like a real team effort. In contrast, the second image shows a family relaxing on the sofa, completely hands-off, while a robot vacuum does the work for them. So, the main difference is the contrast between active, collaborative work and using technology to free up time for leisure.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men bir oilani ko'ryapman. Ular tozalayapti. Va bir robot.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men bir oilani ko'ryapman. Ular uyni tozalashyapti. Va men bir robotni ko'ryapman. Robot ham tozalayapti, lekin u boshqacha, chunki u oila emas.
questions.uzSampleB1: Birinchi rasmda men bir oilani tozalash bilan shug'ullanayotganini ko'ryapman. Ular baxtiyor ko'rinadi. Ular birgalikda ishlayapti. Ikkinchi rasmda men tozalayotgan robotni ko'ryapman. Menimcha, bu qiziqarli, chunki biri oila, ikkinchisi esa robot.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Birinchi rasmda bir oila a'zolari birgalikda uy ishlarini qilayotganini ko'rish mumkin. Ular uy tozalash bilan mashg'ul va bundan zavqlanayotganga o'xshaydi.
Shunga qaramay, ikkinchi rasm butunlay boshqacha. Unda robot tozalash ishlarini qilayotgani tasvirlangan. Ularni solishtirish qiziq, chunki birida odamlar birgalikda ishlayotgani, ikkinchisida esa texnologiya biz uchun ishlayotgani ko'rsatilgan.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - What do you see in these pictures?
idioms: many hands make light work - "qo'l ko'p bo'lsa, ish yengil"
a picture is worth a thousand words - "bir rasm ming so'zga arziydi"
home sweet home - "uyim — uyim, o'lsam ham shu joyim"
sentenceStarters: "In the first picture, I can see a family…" - "Birinchi rasmda men oilani … ko'ryapman"
"The contrast between the two images is…" - "Ikki rasm orasidagi farq…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
In the first picture, I can see a family enthusiastically cleaning their home together. Each family member seems to be doing their part — some are sweeping, others are tidying up — and they appear to be enjoying the shared activity. It gives a warm feeling of teamwork and togetherness.
In the second picture, there's a person sitting comfortably in a chair while a robot takes care of the cleaning. The contrast between the two images is quite striking — one shows the value of collective effort, while the other highlights how technology is increasingly replacing domestic tasks.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi rasmda men bir oilani uyini birgalikda ishtiyoq bilan tozalayotganini ko'ryapman. Har bir oila a'zosi o'z hissasini qo'shayotganga o'xshaydi — ba'zilari supuradi, boshqalari tartibga soladi — va ular umumiy faoliyatdan zavqlanayotganga o'xshaydi. Bu jamoaviy ish va birlikning iliq tuyg'usini beradi.

Ikkinchi rasmda esa, bir odam stulda qulay o'tiribdi, robot esa tozalash bilan shug'ullanmoqda. Ikkala rasm o'rtasidagi farq juda sezilarli — biri jamoaviy harakatning qadrini ko'rsatsa, ikkinchisi texnologiyaning uy ishlarini tobora ko'proq almashtirayotganini ta'kidlaydi.

questions.prompt: Why do some families still prefer to clean their homes themselves?
questions.sampleA1: I clean my home. It is my home. I like clean.
questions.sampleA2: I clean my home. It is important. My family helps and it is good. We don't like strangers in our house, so we clean it ourselves.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some families clean their homes because it's cheaper. They don't have to pay someone else. Also, maybe they like doing it. It's like exercise. For example, my grandma likes cleaning. She says it keeps her busy. But I don't like it very much.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I suppose there are a couple of reasons. For one thing, doing the chores together is a great way of family bonding — everyone pitches in and it strengthens family ties. On top of that, some people simply don't trust a machine to do a thorough job, so they'd rather roll up their sleeves and add that personal touch themselves.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men uyimni tozalamoqchiman. Bu mening uyim. Men tozalikni yaxshi ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men uyimni tozalamoqdaman. Bu muhim. Mening oilam yordam beradi va bu yaxshi. Biz uyimizda begonalarni yoqtirmaymiz, shuning uchun uni o'zimiz tozalamiz.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi oilalar uylarini tozalashadi, chunki bu arzonroq. Ular boshqa birovga pul to'lashlari shart emas. Shuningdek, ehtimol, ularga bu yoqadi. Bu xuddi mashq qilishdek. Masalan, mening buvim tozalashni yaxshi ko'radi. Uning aytishicha, bu uni band qiladi. Lekin menga bu unchalik yoqmaydi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Oilalar o'z uylarini o'zlari tozalashni afzal ko'rishlarining bir nechta sababi bor. Birinchidan, bu nazorat masalasi bo'lishi mumkin. Ular qanday mahsulotlar ishlatilayotganini va tozalash qanchalik puxta bajarilayotganini aniq bilishadi. Ikkinchidan, ba'zi oilalar uchun bu pulni tejash bilan bog'liq, ayniqsa, agar ular qattiq byudjetda bo'lishsa. Tozalash xizmatini yollash ancha qimmatga tushishi mumkin. Nihoyat, ba'zi odamlar tozalashni terapevtik deb bilishadi; bu stressdan xalos bo'lish va o'zini samarali his qilish usuli. Bu ularga o'z muhitini nazorat qilish imkonini beradi.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - Why do some families still prefer to clean their homes themselves?
idioms: if you want something done right, do it yourself - "agar ish to'g'ri bo'lishini istasang, o'zing qil"
pitch in - "hissasini qo'shmoq"
elbow grease - "qo'l mehnati, tirishqoqlik"
sentenceStarters: "There are several reasons why many families still prefer…" - "Ko'p oilalar hali ham … ni afzal ko'rishining bir necha sababi bor"
"Cleaning together can be a form of family bonding…" - "Birgalikda tozalash oilaviy yaqinlashishning bir shakli bo'lishi mumkin…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are several reasons why many families still prefer to clean their homes themselves despite the availability of modern technology. Firstly, cleaning together can be a form of family bonding. When everyone pitches in, it creates a sense of shared responsibility and teamwork, which strengthens family ties.
Secondly, many people find manual cleaning genuinely satisfying — there's a sense of accomplishment that comes from seeing your home sparkle as a result of your own efforts. It also teaches children important life skills and the value of hard work.
Furthermore, some families simply don't trust machines to do as thorough a job as a human can. They prefer the personal touch and the ability to pay attention to areas that a robot might miss. As the saying goes, "if you want something done right, do it yourself."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ko'pgina oilalar zamonaviy texnologiyalar mavjudligiga qaramay, hali ham o'z uylarini o'zlari tozalashni afzal ko'rishlarining bir nechta sabablari bor. Birinchidan, birgalikda tozalash oilaviy rishtalarni mustahkamlashning bir shakli bo'lishi mumkin. Hamma o'z hissasini qo'shganda, bu umumiy mas'uliyat va jamoaviy ish tuyg'usini yaratadi, bu esa oilaviy aloqalarni mustahkamlaydi.

Ikkinchidan, ko'p odamlar qo'lda tozalashdan chinakam qoniqish his qilishadi — o'z harakatlaringiz natijasida uyingizning yorqinligini ko'rishdan kelib chiqadigan yutuq hissi bor. Bundan tashqari, u bolalarga muhim hayotiy ko'nikmalarni va mehnatning qadrini o'rgatadi.

Bundan tashqari, ba'zi oilalar shunchaki mashinalar inson qila oladigan darajada puxta ish qilishiga ishonmaydi. Ular shaxsiy yondashuvni va robot e'tibordan chetda qoldirishi mumkin bo'lgan joylarga e'tibor qaratish qobiliyatini afzal ko'rishadi. Maqol aytganidek, "biror narsa to'g'ri bajarilishini istasangiz, uni o'zingiz qiling."

questions.prompt: If robots could do all household chores, how might family life and relationships change?
questions.sampleA1: Robot do clean. I have free time. Good.
questions.sampleA2: Robot clean house. I happy. I can watch TV and play games. My family is happy too because no cleaning.
questions.sampleB1: If robots do the chores, I think family life would be different. For example, we would have more time to do fun things together. However, maybe kids wouldn't learn how to clean. In my opinion, it could be good and bad.
questions.sampleB2: That's an interesting one. On the plus side, families would have far more quality time to spend together, which could bring them closer. That said, there's a flip side — if kids never lift a finger, they might grow up without a real sense of responsibility. So honestly, it's a bit of a double-edged sword.
questions.uzSampleA1: Robot tozalashni qiladi. Menda bo'sh vaqt bo'ladi. Yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Robot uy tozalaydi. Men xursandman. Men televizor ko'rishim va o'yinlar o'ynashim mumkin. Mening oilam ham xursand, chunki tozalash yo'q.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Agar robotlar uy ishlarini qilsa, menimcha oilaviy hayot boshqacha bo'ladi.
Masalan, bizda birgalikda qiziqarli ishlar qilish uchun ko'proq vaqt bo'ladi.
Biroq, balki bolalar tozalashni o'rganmas.
Mening fikrimcha, bu yaxshi ham, yomon ham bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Agar robotlar uy ishlarining hammasini qilsa, oilaviy hayot ancha o'zgarishi mumkin. O'ylashimcha, odamlarda ancha ko'p bo'sh vaqt bo'ladi, ular bu vaqtdan sevimli mashg'ulotlari bilan shug'ullanish yoki birgalikda sifatli vaqt o'tkazish uchun foydalanishlari mumkin. Bu, albatta, oila ichidagi munosabatlarni yaxshilashi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, agar bolalar hech qachon uy ishlarini qilishga majbur bo'lmasa, ular muhim hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rganmasligi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, qo'shimcha bo'sh vaqtdan kim foydalanishi va uni qanday o'tkazish kerakligi haqida bahslar bo'lishi mumkin. Shunday qilib, ijobiy ham, salbiy ham oqibatlari bo'lishi mumkin.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - If robots could do all household chores, how might family life and relationships change?
idioms: every coin has two sides - "har bir tanganing ikki tomoni bor"
too much of a good thing - "yaxshi narsaning ham ko'pi zararli"
necessity is the mother of invention - "ehtiyoj — ixtironing onasi"
sentenceStarters: "If robots could handle all household chores, family life would…" - "Agar robotlar barcha uy ishlarini bajara olsa, oila hayoti…"
"There could also be some unintended consequences…" - "Kutilmagan oqibatlar ham bo'lishi mumkin…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
If robots could handle all household chores, family life would undoubtedly change in several significant ways. On the positive side, families would have much more free time to spend together on meaningful activities — going on outings, playing games, or simply talking. This could potentially lead to stronger emotional bonds between family members.
However, there could also be some unintended consequences. Household chores are often a way for families to work together as a team, teaching children responsibility and the importance of contributing to the household. Without these tasks, children might grow up with a weaker sense of duty and less appreciation for hard work.
Moreover, if people become too reliant on robots, they might lose basic practical skills like cooking and cleaning — skills that are essential for independent living. While technology can make life easier, it's important to strike a balance so that convenience doesn't come at the cost of personal development.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Agar robotlar barcha uy ishlarini bajara olsa, oilaviy hayot, shubhasiz, bir necha muhim jihatdan o'zgaradi. Ijobiy tomondan, oilalar birgalikda mazmunli mashg'ulotlar bilan shug'ullanish uchun ko'proq bo'sh vaqtga ega bo'lishadi — sayohatlarga chiqish, o'yinlar o'ynash yoki shunchaki suhbatlashish. Bu oila a'zolari o'rtasida kuchliroq hissiy bog'lanishlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Biroq, ba'zi kutilmagan oqibatlar ham bo'lishi mumkin. Uy ishlari ko'pincha oilalar uchun bir jamoa bo'lib ishlash, bolalarga mas'uliyatni va uy xo'jaligiga hissa qo'shish muhimligini o'rgatish usuli hisoblanadi. Ushbu vazifalar bo'lmasa, bolalar zaifroq burch hissi bilan va mehnatni kamroq qadrlash bilan ulg'ayishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, agar odamlar robotlarga juda bog'lanib qolsalar, ular ovqat pishirish va tozalash kabi asosiy amaliy ko'nikmalarni yo'qotishlari mumkin — bu mustaqil hayot uchun zarur bo'lgan ko'nikmalar. Texnologiya hayotni osonlashtirishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, qulaylik shaxsiy rivojlanish hisobiga kelmasligi uchun muvozanatni saqlash muhimdir.

questions.prompt: Describe a time when a book or film deeply influenced you.
questions.sampleA1: I like the book. It is good. The book make me happy.
questions.sampleA2: I like the movie. It is about a dog. The dog is very good and I like the dog. I was sad when the dog was lost, but it was happy in the end.
questions.sampleB1: I remember a film that influenced me. It was called 'Forrest Gump'. I think it's a really good movie. It showed me that even if you have problems, you can still do amazing things. It made me feel like I could do anything I set my mind to.
questions.sampleB2: Right, I'd like to talk about a film that genuinely left its mark on me — 'The Pursuit of Happyness' with Will Smith. To give you a bit of background, I watched it during my final year at school, when I was honestly going through a rough patch and feeling pretty demoralised about my future. The film follows Chris Gardner, a struggling salesman who ends up homeless yet refuses to give up on his dream of becoming a stockbroker. Watching him sleep in train-station toilets with his little son while never losing hope — well, it moved me to tears, to be honest. What struck me most was his unwavering determination in the face of such hardship. As for how it changed me, it completely turned my thinking around. Before, I used to throw in the towel the moment things got tough, but the film drove home the idea that setbacks are only temporary. It taught me the value of sheer perseverance — that if you keep your chin up and put in the graft, things do eventually fall into place. Ever since, I've tried to face challenges with a far more positive frame of mind. As for why creative works have such a powerful hold on society, I reckon it's because they tap into universal emotions — hope, fear, love, ambition — that we can all relate to. A well-told story doesn't just entertain; it can shift attitudes, challenge deeply held beliefs and even spark real change. At the end of the day, that's the magic of storytelling.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga kitob yoqadi. U yaxshi. Kitob meni xursand qiladi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga kino yoqadi. U it haqida. It juda yaxshi va menga it yoqadi. It yo'qolganida xafa bo'ldim, lekin oxirida baxtli bo'ldi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Esimda, menga ta'sir qilgan bir film bor. U "Forrest Gump" deb nomlangan edi. Menimcha, bu juda yaxshi kino. U menga hatto muammolaringiz bo'lsa ham, ajoyib ishlarni qila olishingizni ko'rsatdi. Bu meni o'z oldimga qo'ygan har qanday narsani qila oladigandek his qildirdi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Menga katta ta'sir ko'rsatgan film bu "Yovvoyi tabiatga" ("Into the Wild") edi. Bu yosh yigitning jamiyat normalarini rad etishi va Alyaska cho'llarida yolg'izlik hayotini izlashi haqidagi hikoya. Film baxt va muvaffaqiyat haqidagi o'z taxminlarimga qarshi chiqdi. Men uning haddan tashqari tanlovlariga qo'shilmasam ham, bu meni ilgari o'z-o'zidan qabul qilgan qadriyatlarimni so'roq qilishga va men uchun nima muhimligini ko'rib chiqishga majbur qildi. Bu, albatta, yashashning muqobil usullari va o'z-o'zini kashf etishning ahamiyati haqidagi qarashlarimni kengaytirdi.

bulletPoints: Describe a time when a book or film deeply influenced you.
How did it make you think or feel differently?
Why do creative works have such a strong impact on society?
questions.sampleAnswer:
A time when a book or film deeply influenced me:
I'd like to talk about the film "The Pursuit of Happyness," which profoundly influenced my outlook on life. I watched it during a particularly challenging period in my studies when I was feeling quite discouraged. The story of Chris Gardner — a homeless man who relentlessly pursued his dream of becoming a stockbroker — moved me to tears. His unwavering determination in the face of extreme hardship was incredibly inspiring.
How it made me think or feel differently:
After watching that film, I began to see my own struggles in a completely different light. Whereas before I felt like giving up, the story reminded me that temporary setbacks don't define your future. It taught me the value of resilience and persistence — that no matter how difficult things seem, you should never stop working towards your goals. I started approaching my challenges with a much more positive mindset.
Why creative works have such a strong impact on society:
I believe creative works have such a powerful impact because they tap into universal emotions — love, fear, hope, struggle — that everyone can relate to. A well-crafted story can change perspectives, challenge deeply held beliefs, and even inspire social movements. As the saying goes, "the pen is mightier than the sword" — art and storytelling have always been powerful tools for shaping public opinion and inspiring change.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Kitob yoki filmning menga chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatgan vaqti:
Men hayotga bo'lgan qarashimga chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatgan "Baxt izlab" filmi haqida gapirmoqchiman. Men uni o'qishlarimning ayniqsa qiyin davrida, juda tushkunlikka tushgan paytimda tomosha qilganman. Chris Gardnerning hikoyasi - uy-joysiz odam, u tinimsiz ravishda fond birjasi brokeri bo'lish orzusiga intilgan - meni ko'z yoshlarimga to'ldirdi. Uning o'ta qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, qat'iyati juda ilhomlantiruvchi edi.
U meni qanday fikrlashga yoki his qilishga majbur qildi:
O'sha filmni tomosha qilganimdan so'ng, men o'z kurashlarimni butunlay boshqacha nuqtai nazardan ko'ra boshladim. Ilgari men taslim bo'lishni xohlagan bo'lsam, hikoya menga vaqtinchalik muvaffaqiyatsizliklar kelajagingizni belgilamasligini eslatdi. U menga chidamlilik va qat'iyatning qadrini o'rgatdi - ishlar qanchalik qiyin bo'lib tuyulmasin, siz hech qachon o'z maqsadlaringiz sari harakat qilishni to'xtatmasligingiz kerak. Men o'z muammolarimga ancha ijobiy fikr bilan yondasha boshladim.
Nima uchun ijodiy ishlar jamiyatga shunchalik kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatadi:
Menimcha, ijodiy ishlar shunchalik kuchli ta'sirga ega, chunki ular hamma bilan bog'liq bo'lgan umumiy his-tuyg'ularni - sevgi, qo'rquv, umid, kurashni o'z ichiga oladi. Yaxshi yaratilgan hikoya nuqtai nazarni o'zgartirishi, chuqur e'tiqodlarga qarshi chiqishi va hatto ijtimoiy harakatlarga ilhom berishi mumkin. Aytganlaridek, "qalam qilichdan kuchliroq" - san'at va hikoyalar har doim jamoatchilik fikrini shakllantirish va o'zgarishlarga ilhom berish uchun kuchli vosita bo'lib kelgan.

questions.prompt: Parents should monitor children's internet use.
questions.sampleA1: Yes. Internet is... bad. Children... need help. Mom and dad... watch.
questions.sampleA2: I think parents should watch the internet. Because the internet has bad things. And children don't know. But maybe not all the time. It's difficult.
questions.sampleB1: I think parents should monitor children's internet use. It's important because there are dangers online. For example, some websites are not good for kids. However, parents shouldn't control everything. Children also need some privacy. So, it's a difficult situation, in my opinion.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really hot topic these days, and to be honest I can see merit on both sides. Those in favour argue that the internet can be a bit of a minefield for youngsters. Without some sort of oversight, kids can easily stumble upon harmful content — things like violence, misinformation or worse. On top of that, the threat of online predators is very real, so a bit of monitoring can act as a crucial safety net and help children pick up responsible digital habits early on. On the other hand, the critics do have a point. If parents are breathing down their kids' necks the whole time, it can seriously eat away at the trust between them. Children who feel spied on tend to become secretive rather than open. What's more, being overly strict can actually hold back a child's independence and their ability to stand on their own two feet. Ironically, tech-savvy kids will often just find clever ways to get around the restrictions anyway. So where do I stand? Personally, I reckon open communication beats surveillance every time. Rather than snooping, parents would be far better off having honest conversations and setting some ground rules together. After all, you can't shield them from everything forever, so teaching them to make sensible choices matters more. As the old saying goes, 'trust, but verify' — a bit of guidance combined with a healthy dose of freedom strikes the right balance, and at the end of the day that's what really counts.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha. Internet... yomon. Bolalar... yordamga muhtoj. Oyi va dada... kuzatishi kerak.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, ota-onalar internetni kuzatib turishlari kerak. Chunki internetda yomon narsalar bor. Va bolalar bilishmaydi. Lekin balki har doim emas. Bu qiyin.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, ota-onalar bolalarning internetdan foydalanishini nazorat qilishlari kerak. Bu muhim, chunki internetda xavflar bor.
Masalan, ba'zi veb-saytlar bolalar uchun yaxshi emas.
Biroq, ota-onalar hamma narsani nazorat qilmasliklari kerak. Bolalarga ham biroz shaxsiy hayot kerak. Shunday qilib, bu qiyin vaziyat, menimcha.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Menimcha, ota-onalar farzandlarining internetdagi faoliyatini nazorat qilish mas'uliyatiga ega, garchi bu nazoratning darajasi bahsli bo'lsa ham. Internetning ko'plab xavflarni keltirib chiqarishi inkor etib bo'lmaydi, jumladan, nomaqbul kontentga duchor bo'lishdan tortib, kiberbulling xavfigacha.
Boshqa tomondan, haddan tashqari nazorat ishonchni yo'qotishi va bolaning mustaqil qaror qabul qilish qobiliyatini bo'g'ishi mumkin.
Shuning uchun, muvozanatli yondashuv muhim. Ota-onalar farzandlarini onlayn xavfsizlik haqida o'qitishlari va ochiq muloqotni rivojlantirishlari, shuningdek, ularning onlayn odatlari haqida o'rtacha darajada xabardor bo'lishlari kerak.

questions.sampleAnswer:
This is an extremely relevant debate in today's digital age. Those in favour of monitoring argue that the internet can be a dangerous place for young and vulnerable children. Without proper oversight, children may be exposed to harmful content such as violence, misinformation, or inappropriate material. Moreover, the threat of cyber predators is very real, and parental monitoring can serve as a crucial safety net. By keeping an eye on their children's online activity, parents can also encourage responsible digital habits from an early age.
However, opponents make some compelling points. Constant monitoring can seriously damage the trust between parents and children. If children feel they are being watched all the time, they may become secretive rather than open about their online experiences. Furthermore, excessive control can hinder the development of independence and self-regulation — skills that are essential for adulthood. Interestingly, strict monitoring often backfires, as tech-savvy children find creative ways to bypass restrictions, making the whole effort counterproductive.
Personally, I believe that open communication is far more effective than surveillance. Parents should educate their children about online safety and build a relationship based on trust, rather than relying solely on monitoring tools. As the proverb goes, "trust, but verify" — a balanced approach that combines guidance with a degree of oversight is the most sensible path forward.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu bugungi raqamli davrda juda dolzarb bahs. Kuzatuvni yoqlovchilar internet yosh va himoyasiz bolalar uchun xavfli joy bo'lishi mumkinligini ta'kidlaydilar. Tegishli nazorat bo'lmasa, bolalar zo'ravonlik, noto'g'ri ma'lumot yoki nomaqbul materiallar kabi zararli kontentga duch kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, kiber yirtqichlar tahdidi juda real va ota-onalarning kuzatuvi muhim xavfsizlik tarmog'i bo'lib xizmat qilishi mumkin. Ota-onalar farzandlarining onlayn faoliyatini kuzatib borish orqali, shuningdek, erta yoshdan mas'uliyatli raqamli odatlarni rag'batlantirishlari mumkin.

Biroq, qarshilar ba'zi ishonarli dalillarni keltiradilar. Doimiy kuzatuv ota-onalar va bolalar o'rtasidagi ishonchga jiddiy zarar yetkazishi mumkin. Agar bolalar doimo kuzatilayotganini his qilsalar, ular onlayn tajribalari haqida ochiq bo'lishdan ko'ra, sirli bo'lib qolishlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, haddan tashqari nazorat mustaqillik va o'zini o'zi tartibga solish rivojlanishiga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin - bu kattalar hayoti uchun zarur bo'lgan ko'nikmalar. Qizig'i shundaki, qattiq nazorat ko'pincha teskari natija beradi, chunki texnologiyani yaxshi biladigan bolalar cheklovlarni chetlab o'tishning ijodiy usullarini topadilar va bu butun urinishni samarasiz qiladi.

Shaxsan men, ochiq muloqot kuzatuvdan ko'ra ancha samaraliroq, deb hisoblayman. Ota-onalar farzandlariga onlayn xavfsizlik haqida ta'lim berishlari va faqat kuzatuv vositalariga tayanishdan ko'ra, ishonchga asoslangan munosabatlarni qurishlari kerak. Maqolda aytilganidek, "ishon, lekin tekshir" - yo'l-yo'riqni ma'lum darajadagi nazorat bilan birlashtirgan muvozanatli yondashuv - bu oldinga siljishning eng oqilona yo'li.
